_comment: Digests of the cite.py corpus dumps, which are no longer committed as text (~800 KB whose only job was to make a failure readable). The dump is byte-deterministic from the pinned spec copies, so the old output is reproducible from the old code: to see what a digest change means, regenerate on both sides (dump_goldens.py --write corpus, once on your branch and once with the change stashed) and diff the two. The regenerated text is gitignored. cite-find.txt stays committed as text: it is small, and its diffs are the readable ones.
